The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d0cda0544b3c1b1b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. statement: Fix 0 < ε < 1 and an integer R ≥ 1. Suppose that for every masa A ⊆ M admitting a faithful A-central normal state φ, every self-adjoint contraction x ∈ M, and every ρ > 0, there exist a partition of 1 into R projections of A, a self-adjoint a ∈ A of norm at most one, and a projection q ∈ M with φ(1 − q) < ρ and q R X i=1 pixpi − a ! q ≤ ε. Then every masa in every represented von Neumann algebra has the strong-operator paving property of Theorem 1.1 at error ε, with r = R + ⌈4/ε⌉ + 1. In particular this number is chosen before the finite vector set and the strong-neighborhood tolerance.
